cells.gaps: No share of the 351 communes' town halls connected is published: the 78 is a count of principal civil status centres networked in 2025, with no total and not said by its source to be mairies, and the only town halls named on RESINA are five in 2020 (BFA-009), so the two counts measure different things. No fact says commune staff work in a national system over the connection, and no finance fact falls inside the 36 months (the domestic line in BFA-012 is 2020).
cells.note: Town halls outside the capital are on RESINA, provided by the state with email and web access, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half on a share or a count with a denominator, and the evidence gives only counts without a total.
